provenance.captureMethod: SerpApi Apple Reviews engine (country=us, sort=mostrecent, no_cache=true)
provenance.privacyMinimization: reviewer nickname, author URI, and sensitive headers removed; review id/rating/title/body/version/updatedAt retained

analysis.goal: Analyze the most impactful problems and opportunities from US App Store reviews. Identify the most polarizing features — loved by some users, disliked by others — especially around subscription value and workout usability. Capture conflicting feedback explicitly instead of discarding it.
